purpose: Explicit migration ledger for architectural contracts that remain live during the Atlas transition. Deprecation never means delete immediately; removal requires replacement coverage, compatibility handling and passing audits.

removal_conditions: homepage no longer requires exactly five primary doors
all major branches resolve through Atlas Nodes or Views
legacy routes remain compatible
public projection validators have Atlas replacements
branch pages are generated as Views rather than ownership containers
all durable manifest records have canonical owners in Atlas or explicit Artifact roles
machine discovery no longer consumes manifest branches as ontology

entries.role: legacy public artifact builder and generated topic/record page owner
removal_conditions: all retained specialist outputs have focused builders
Atlas reader adapters replace generic JSON rendering
public build orchestrator owns the complete build sequence
final sitemap/discovery coverage remains complete

entries.role: five-door-aware question and machine discovery projection
removal_conditions: question pages route through canonical Atlas identities
machine discovery reads Nodes/Views rather than five primary doors
A-Z and question URLs remain compatible

entries.role: legacy five-door and specialist-route public shell validator
removal_conditions: new summit and Room navigation is live
legacy route checks move into compatibility validation
validator performs no output mutation

entries.role: legacy archive/explorer and mixed public styling owner
removal_conditions: all public structural selectors use named namespaces
legacy explorer either migrates or remains isolated under a legacy layer
CSS collision audit reports no dependency on generic structural owners
protected legacy markup count reaches zero
namespace validator passes without guard exceptions
responsive shell tests remain green after removal
